name: nous-os-ui
description: Renderer-neutral visual engine and 2D renderer over the projection IR.

scripts.test:unit: mkdir -p dist/evidence && rm -f dist/evidence/unit-results.tap dist/evidence/unit-result.json && node --test --test-reporter=spec --test-reporter-destination=stdout --test-reporter=tap --test-reporter-destination=dist/evidence/unit-results.tap "test/**/*.test.ts"; result=$?; UNIT_TEST_EXIT_CODE=$result node --input-type=module --eval 'import { createHash } from "node:crypto";import { readFile, writeFile } from "node:fs/promises";const resultPath=["dist","evidence","unit-results.tap"].join("/");const metadataPath=["dist","evidence","unit-result.json"].join("/");const gitDirectory=["..",".git"].join("/");const selection=["test/**/*.test.ts"];const executedCommand=["node","--test","--test-reporter=spec","--test-reporter-destination=stdout","--test-reporter=tap","--test-reporter-destination=dist/evidence/unit-results.tap",...selection].join(" ");const commit=async()=>{try{const head=(await readFile(gitDirectory+"/HEAD","utf8")).trim();let sha=head;if(head.startsWith("ref: ")){const ref=head.slice(5);try{sha=(await readFile(gitDirectory+"/"+ref,"utf8")).trim();}catch{const packed=await readFile(gitDirectory+"/packed-refs","utf8");const lines=packed.split("\n").filter((line)=>line.endsWith(" "+ref)).sort();sha=lines.length===1?lines[0].split(" ")[0]:"";}}return /^[0-9a-f]{40,64}$/i.test(sha)?sha:"unavailable";}catch{return "unavailable";}};let reporterSha256=null;try{reporterSha256=createHash("sha256").update(await readFile(resultPath)).digest("hex");}catch{}await writeFile(metadataPath,JSON.stringify({schemaVersion:2,command:"npm --prefix ui run test:unit",executedCommand,selection,commitSha:await commit(),exitCode:Number(process.env.UNIT_TEST_EXIT_CODE),reporter:{name:"tap",path:resultPath,sha256:reporterSha256}},null,2)+"\n");'; exit $result
